name: iumrah-beta-update-20260915-account-activation-email-security-v6
base: kepler-ios-main 4.zip; compatible with Home/Care layout v5 because file sets do not overlap
root_cause: Booking activation still called the legacy /api/catalog/hotels/client/account/activate endpoint while current password/email/Apple/Google security lives in PackageEngine. The legacy accountActive flag can also represent a provisional booking profile rather than user-established credentials.
notes: Moves booking activation to /api/package/client/account/activate and verifies the booking with x-booking-token against BOOKINGS_DB.
Repairs provisional iumrah_accounts rows only when no established login/email/Apple/Google/device/session signal exists; established accounts return ACCOUNT_ALREADY_ACTIVE.
Adds booking activation through verified email using existing Resend challenge infrastructure.
Activation UI defaults to account creation, not legacy accountActive; native segmented iumrah ID / Email selector, create/confirm password, eye controls and iumrah Security copy.
Existing-account checkout login supports iumrah ID or verified email and links the booking to the authenticated canonical account.
Account tab supports iumrah ID or email/password login plus Forgot password; Apple and Google are preserved.
Password recovery UI now has production password confirmation, eye visibility controls and security guidance.
No TestFlight workflow, signing, project.yml, resources, Home/Care/Hotels layouts, pricing, or payment files are included.
Backend changes require running the existing “Deploy iumrah Package Engine” workflow after the ZIP is applied. Existing RESEND_API_KEY Worker secret is reused; this patch does not modify secrets.
